capability: Keep the doc and the build matching on every change
title: Two copies, one seam.

hook.picture: Close: two lines run side by side like rails, the doc above and the build below. The whale edits the lower one only, and the rails start to part.
hook.words: We changed the build, not the doc.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The build quietly stopped matching the design doc.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: The two rails fan out across the screen: many edits, each to one rail only. Three more one-sided edits, accelerating.

stakes.body: The doc lies to everyone who builds from it, and the next agent or hire builds the wrong thing.

solution_hint: Compare both copies on every change.

metaphor.body: Doc and build are two rails. Short seams join them at each shared point, and a gate waits until both sides match, so the rails always step together.

steps.picture: Short dashed seams appear between the rails at each shared point. At each one the two dots must sit level.
The whale edits the build rail. A seam stretches and glows rust, and a gate on the rail closes until the doc rail is updated too.
steps.words: One side changed? The gate waits.
steps.sound: Tones beat, then a gate thud.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28). The whale updates the doc dot. The seam shortens and ticks teal, the gate opens, and both rails step together.
steps.words: Checks live where the copies meet: seams.

steps.picture: Each matched seam leaves a tick on the strip.

real_case.claim: Escape register: a build silently diverged from its design document. It slipped past because nothing compared them, and it is now caught by AP-54 conformance.

honest_limit.picture: A feature neither rail mentions slides between them. No seam exists there, so nothing glows.
honest_limit.words: Missing from both copies? Nothing glows.

not_this.body: Matching copies can both be wrong.

ending_pattern.body: The same one-sided edit now makes its seam glow until the doc follows, and the two rails curve together through a long bend.
ending_pattern.callback: The rails that parted in bar 1 now run parallel through a curve, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Two copies? Check them where they meet.
